description: This API is used to store and read data on EYWA hosted database. Usually this includes sync, stack, slice, search, get, delete, purge operations on modeled and deployed Datasets.
name: Synthigy

scopes.description: Allows user to view saved datasets
scopes.name: dataset:load

scopes.description: Subscribe to model-deploy notifications (deployed-model / runtime-model tracks on /data/subscription)
scopes.name: dataset:subscription

scopes.description: Allows a client to introspect the deployed model and compile XSQL to typed codegen IR (the `describe` operation behind `gen --pull`). Read-only: no row data.
scopes.name: schema:read

scopes.description: Allows user to delete dataset, and all tables that are specific only to that dataset
scopes.name: dataset:delete

scopes.description: Allows user to deploy dataset models
scopes.name: dataset:deploy

scopes.description: Change logging configuration at runtime (levels, destinations, taps)
scopes.name: log:configure

scopes.description: Read observability data — log queries, histograms and traffic statistics
scopes.name: log:read
